lines.name: Kings Letter
lines.text: By command of the Crown, thou art to ride at once to the village of AAAB.

lines.name: Kings Letter
lines.text: Deliver this letter to the village elder without delay. Ensure the village stands in good order and suffers no distress worthy of report.

lines.name: Kings Letter
lines.text: Obtain a written reply from the elder and return immediately to my court. There is no time to linger — the affairs of the realm will not wait.

lines.name: Kings Letter
lines.text: See this task done swiftly and faithfully. (King of the Kingdom)
